map.name: Fort Skarn
map.setting: a frozen fort on a mountain pass
map.trouble: Kolgrath the Necromancer holds Kel Dorran at the top of the pass and raises the frozen dead against Fort Skarn, and the pass is shut.

guard_bark.specifics: Tormod at the East Gate, shut by Warden Brannoc while Kolgrath's Undead walk the pass.

first.speaker: Tormod
first.text: Halt! The East Gate is shut by order of Warden Brannoc. Nobody goes up the pass while the Undead are on it.

again.speaker: Tormod
again.text: You again? The gate's shut. Go and get warm by the fire in the Iron Kettle.

later.speaker: Tormod
later.text: The Warden says you may pass. Go on through. And mind the ice!

bounty_offer.specifics: Dagny the cook: Bears dig into the fort's meat store behind the kitchen every night.

offer.speaker: Dagny
offer.text:
Bears! Big hungry Black Bears, in my meat store! They dig in through the snow behind the kitchen every night and eat the soldiers' supper!

The Warden won't spare me a single man, they're all up on the walls watching for the Undead. Kill those beasts and I'll pay you well, I promise!

reminder.speaker: Dagny
reminder.text: Hurry! There won't be a scrap of meat left for supper!

completion.speaker: Dagny
completion.text: You killed them? Ha! The soldiers will eat tonight! Here's your gold, a hundred pieces, just like I promised.

journal.text: Kill the Bears raiding Dagny's meat store behind the kitchen.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Elko the Lookout: Urchins from the Ice Caves stole his magic spyglass off the north wall.

offer.speaker: Elko
offer.text:
Blast it all! How am I supposed to watch the pass now?

The Urchins crept up the north wall last night and made off with my spyglass! A magic one, it is. They live down in the Ice Caves below the wall.

Without it, Kolgrath's Undead could be at the gate before anybody sees them! Will you get it back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Elko
refusal.text: Bah! Then we're as good as blind up here.

reminder.speaker: Elko
reminder.text: Did you find my spyglass? I can't see a thing up here!

completion.speaker: Elko
completion.text: My spyglass! Ha, ha! I can see all the way to Kel Dorran again! Thank you, lad. Here, take this for your trouble.

after.speaker: Elko
after.text: Thanks again, lad! Nothing gets past old Elko now.

journal.text: Recover Elko's spyglass from the Urchins in the Ice Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Elko's spyglass from the Urchins in the Ice Caves.

rumour.specifics: Ulla, Grindle and Fitch, folk of Fort Skarn.

rumour1.speaker: Ulla
rumour1.text: Cold, cold, cold! I haven't felt my toes since spring.

rumour2.speaker: Grindle
rumour2.text: Warden Brannoc hasn't slept a wink since the Undead came down the pass. Poor man looks worse than they do!

rumour3.speaker: Fitch
rumour3.text: Nibbs is in the cell again for cheating at dice. He'll talk your ear off if you let him.

shop_greeting.specifics: Hobb of the Iron Kettle, Bodmar the smith, Ysmay the potion-seller.

inn.speaker: Hobb
inn.text: Shut the door, yer lettin' the snow in! Now, what'll it be? Hot cider's on the fire.

arms.speaker: Bodmar
arms.text: Welcome to Bodmar's Armory! Swords, shields, good thick armor. Can I help you?

magic.speaker: Ysmay
magic.text: Hello, hello! Potions, scrolls, spell books! I hear the Undead don't care for fire... and I just happen to have a few fire spells!

two_givers.specifics: Brother Ennick wants the risen dead in the chapel crypt put down; Nibbs, locked up for cheating at dice, wants the jailer's key.

offer_a.speaker: Brother Ennick
offer_a.text:
Greetings, my son. Grave tidings, I fear. Kolgrath's foul magic has reached even into our chapel. The honored dead in the crypt below have risen from their rest!

I am a man of prayer, not of the sword. Go down into the crypt and lay them to rest again, and the chapel will see you rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Nibbs
offer_b.text:
Psst! You there! Yes, you! Come closer.

They locked me up for one little game of dice. Can you believe it? The jailer keeps the key on his belt, and he sleeps through his whole watch.

Bring me that key and I'll tell you where I buried a real beauty of a Longsword. What do you say?

outcome_a.speaker: Brother Ennick
outcome_a.text: The dead sleep again! Bless you, my son. This shield has hung in our chapel for many years. Take it, and may it guard you against Kolgrath's evil.

outcome_b.speaker: Nibbs
outcome_b.text: Hee, hee! Free at last! The Longsword is under the woodpile behind the stable, like I said. And if the Warden asks, you never saw me!

journal_a.text: Destroy the Undead in the crypt beneath the chapel.

journal_b.text: Steal the cell key from the sleeping jailer and free Nibbs.

rescue.specifics: Hulda begs for her husband Ansgar the woodcutter, chased into the old mine on the south slope by the Undead.

plea.speaker: Hulda
plea.text:
Help! Please, somebody help me! My Ansgar went out for firewood this morning and never came back!

One of the soldiers saw him run into the old mine on the south slope with the Undead right behind him. Please, bring him home to me, kind stranger!

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Please hurry! It will be dark soon, and so cold!

found.speaker: Ansgar
found.text: Over here! I'm stuck behind these rocks! Did Hulda send you?

following.speaker: Ansgar
following.text: Hurry, before those things come back!

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: Ansgar! Oh, you're alive! Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this as a token of my thanks. May all good spirits watch over you!

journal.text: Rescue Ansgar the woodcutter from the old mine.

main_opening.specifics: Fitch points the player to Warden Brannoc in the Keep; Brannoc sends him up the pass against Kolgrath the Necromancer at Kel Dorran.

herald.speaker: Fitch
herald.text: So you're the one Ormund sent! Warden Brannoc has been asking for you all morning. He's up in the Keep.

opening.speaker: Warden Brannoc
opening.text:
So, Ormund has sent me help at last! Good. You look a bit thin for this weather, lad, but you'll have to do. Heh, heh.

Kolgrath the Necromancer has taken Kel Dorran, the old fortress at the top of the pass. Every night he raises more of the frozen dead out of the ice and sends them down against our walls. No caravan has come through since the first snow.

Go up the pass to Kel Dorran and put an end to Kolgrath! If Fort Skarn falls, nothing stands between his dead and the valley below. Now off with you, and dress warm!

reminder.speaker: Warden Brannoc
reminder.text: Off with you, lad! Every night you wait, Kolgrath raises more of them.

journal.text: Climb the pass to Kel Dorran and defeat Kolgrath the Necromancer.
